context: Shown when the Creator Hub account differs from the account currently signed into Studio.
source: This sign-in is for a different account. Please sign in to continue.

values.en-us: This sign-in is for a different account. Please sign in to continue.

context: Shown when Studio cannot complete automatic sign-in using the authentication code received from Creator Hub.
source: We couldn't sign you in. Please sign in again.

values.en-us: We couldn't sign you in. Please sign in again.

context: Shown when a network error prevents Studio from completing automatic sign-in using the authentication code received from Creator Hub.
source: Couldn't reach Roblox. Please check your connection and sign in.

values.en-us: Couldn't reach Roblox. Please check your connection and sign in.

context: Shown while Studio is automatically logging the user in - used in a variety of contexts like exchanging the magic auth code from web or when logging users in using stored credentials on account switcher.
Button that links to the Privacy page
Heading that informs the user that they can use this window to sign in.
Text that appears on a button - when the user clicks this button they are taken to the browser to sign in
A button that links to the Terms and Conditions page
The heading for the quick sign in section on the new Studio LoginPage
A subtitle below Heading.SignIn that describes what signing in can do
A string that appears on a popup when the automatic login is occurring
Instructions for users on how to perform quick sign in.
source: Scan this QR code on another device to quickly sign in. Or on your signed in device, go to More > Quick sign in and enter the code.

values.en-us: Scan this QR code on another device to quickly sign in. Or on your signed in device, go to More > Quick sign in and enter the code.

context: Part one of two in the text "Don't have an account? Create one". The "Create one" text will be a link to the Sign Up page on web browser.
Part two of two of the text "Don't have an account? Create one". "Create one" will be a link to sign up on browser.
